slides.headline: 1) WRITE THE EMAIL THAT SELLS YOUR LAUNCH
slides.body: A launch email copywriter charges $800 to $1,500 for one campaign email. This prompt writes it in 90 seconds.

slides.headline: 2) BUILD THE SALES PAGE COLD VISITORS BUY FROM
slides.body: A converting sales page costs $3,000 to $8,000 from a boutique agency. This prompt builds the whole structure, pain, objections, guarantee, in one shot.

slides.headline: 3) GENERATE A FULL WEEK OF LAUNCH POSTS IN ONE SHOT
slides.body: A social media content package for a launch runs $1,500 to $2,500. One prompt covers all seven days.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE THE PRESS RELEASE JOURNALISTS ACTUALLY OPEN
slides.body: PR firms charge $2,000 to $5,000 just to write one release. The prompt below follows the exact format journalists expect.

slides.headline: 5) CLOSE THE CART WITH A 3-EMAIL SEQUENCE
slides.body: Cart-close emails drive 30 to 40% of total launch revenue, yet most founders send just one. This prompt writes all three.

caption:
Swipe through. Five prompts that write every piece of your product launch, from announcement email to cart close. 🚀

The pre-launch announcement email, the sales page that converts cold visitors, a full week of social content, a press release journalists actually open, and the 3-email cart-close sequence that drives most of your launch revenue. Five things agencies charge $8,000 to $15,000 for combined.

Most launches fail because of the writing, not the product. An agency used to be the only way to get launch copy that converts. Now one afternoon with the right prompts covers the whole sequence.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for your next launch.

Sources: Anthropic

pinned_comment: Which piece do you struggle with most: the sales page, the email sequence, or getting press coverage? Slide 5 (the press release) is the one almost nobody thinks to use, and it can bring in thousands of new buyers overnight.

candidates: 5 PROMPTS THAT WRITE YOUR WHOLE PRODUCT LAUNCH OVERNIGHT
YOUR ENTIRE LAUNCH SEQUENCE IS 5 PROMPTS LONG
5 LAUNCH PROMPTS THAT REPLACE YOUR $10,000 AGENCY
$10,000 IN AGENCY WORK IS NOW 5 PROMPTS
hook_tournament.why: [4] leads with the shock of "$10,000" then hits you with "IS NOW"—your brain feels the transformation before you finish reading. [3] makes the same move but buries it at the end, so it reads like an explanation instead of a gut punch.

candidates: THE 5 PROMPTS AGENCIES DON'T WANT YOU TO COPY
$10,000 IN AGENCY WORK IS NOW 5 PROMPTS
THE 5 PROMPTS THAT REPLACE YOUR ENTIRE LAUNCH AGENCY
hook_sharpen.why: The $10,000 number hits like a slap — it's concrete, specific, and makes you stop to process the claim in one read. [0] and [2] tease you with mystery, but [1] tells the actual wild story upfront, so you swipe to see proof, not to solve a riddle.
